PROVINCIAL REGISTRATIONS/ENROLLMENTS

PUNJAB EMPLOYEES SOCIAL SECURITY INSTITUTION
It is hereby notified that in pursuance of Government of the Punjab, Notification No.SO.(Dev1)/PESSI/7-120/2003 dated 18-07-2003, the establishment stands registered with Social Security
Scheme under section 1(3) of Provincial Employees Social Security Ordinance, 1965 w.e.f.
date of start of business or from 01.07.2003, whichever is later.

LABOUR & HUMAN RESOURCE DEPARTMENT
It is hereby certified that the establishment has been registered under The Punjab Shops and
Establishments Ordinance, 1969. The registration is subject to renewal after every 02 years.
